architectureSummary.systemRole: Prefect is an open-source workflow orchestration and durable execution framework providing Python-native flow/task execution, client-server state orchestration, and distributed concurrency controls.

coreSubsystems.name: Engine Core
coreSubsystems.role: Client-side execution loops managing state machine proposals, parameter resolution, and cancellation/suspension.

coreSubsystems.name: Orchestration Server
coreSubsystems.role: State machine transition policy engine validating and mutating proposed states (CoreFlowPolicy, CoreTaskPolicy).

coreSubsystems.name: Results & Caching
coreSubsystems.role: Deterministic cache key calculation, result record persistence to external storage blocks, and replay avoidance.

coreSubsystems.name: Concurrency Engine
coreSubsystems.role: Distributed concurrency limit leases with heartbeat renewal and automatic crash repossession.

coreSubsystems.name: Database Persistence
coreSubsystems.role: Relational state history persistence with optimistic transaction isolation on PostgreSQL and SQLite.
